messages:
maria: Quick note — ran quant int8 bringup for model-x (32k longctx) on staging. Observed intermittent token shift ~2.5k tokens after a long prime. Happens on ~3/10 runs. Logs attached.
chen: Can you paste the exact run command and the prefill snippet?
maria: Sure. Command:
```
./run_infer --model model-x-qint8 --longctx 32768 --prefill ./tests/long_prefill.txt --kv-mode=on
```
Prefill tail (sanitized):
```
[...lots of user/system tokens...]
<user> explain the following premise ...
```
maria: Short log excerpt where it diverges:
```
step=2456 kv_index=2456 rot_phase=0x1f4a
... generation token=... prompt_token_idx=2596 -> emitted_token=\u201cwho\u201d
step=2457 kv_index=2457 rot_phase=0x1f4b
... prompt_token_idx=2597 -> emitted_token=\u201cwhom\u201d  # unexpected
```
aj: :eyes: Is this only on qint8 or reproducible on fp16/amp? Any shard swap or prefetch logs?
maria: Repro on fp16 is rare (1/30), qint8 is ~3/10. No shard swap in logs, but we see a prefetch throttle around the same timeframe in one run.
sophie: Could be a RoPE phase wrap due to big index offset after prefill. Did you try forcing rotary clamp / phase rescale?
maria: Not yet. Hypothesis: quantization + prefix length pushes rotary phase into aliasing region causing effective token misalignment in KV lookup.
ci-bot: build/inf-1234 completed: run-id=ci-1829990-45 — artifacts: /artifacts/ci-1829990-45/logs.tar.gz
chen: Can you run a quick patch with `rotary_phase_rescale=true` and `kv-index-offset-uint32` normalization? Also try `--prefill-batch=1` vs default to rule out batching-induced interleaving.
maria: Starting two runs now: (1) rescale=true (2) prefill-batch=1. Will post results in ~20m. Thanks.
aj: If repro, we should bisect quant kernels + kernel ordering; assign to me if it's consistent.
maria: +1 will assign and upload a minimal repro script if confirmed.
